method: Actually reread all fields of these seven applied revisions against the specific previous findings; reasoned each changed case before issuing new raw-item hashes.
limitations: Independent AI review, not clinician or psychometric validation.
Targeted source checks remain in the corresponding cross-review reports; no blanket source-validation claim.

items.assessment: The stem now supplies persistent malabsorption despite reported correct total daily quantity, leaving meal-linked use to be selected by reasoning rather than an explicit answer phrase. Key and revised rationales align.
The direct action-rule giveaway has been removed. Stool increase with dizziness and little urine now supports clinically important dehydration and urgent oncology advice over mild home care.

All four choices are credible symptom-management plans. Tense pressure limiting eating and breathing despite small meals/positioning makes discussion of drainage the most direct goal-matched option; diuretic and analgesia limitations are case-specific.

The cleansing distractor now describes a plain clinically relevant plan. New open moist skin and pain require review of coverage and analgesia beyond intact-skin emollient, cleansing alone or itch treatment.

Comparable-length alternatives now test addressing nausea and missed doses versus teaching, meal strategies or a premature endpoint. The key manages the concrete barrier without independent dose adjustment.

All alternatives now include clinical outcome information of comparable detail. The key alone improves agreed sleep and transfer goals alongside episode duration; this remains distinct from simple phantom-pain acknowledgement.

The revised alternatives each present temperature, pulse and neurological information. Persistent or worsening neurological findings outweigh partial cooling; restored orientation with target temperature and pulse improvement is the best combined response.
